import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useLLM } from '../../hooks/useLLM'; const LLMSettings: React.FC = () => { const { settings, switchLLM, updateGeminiConfig, updateVLLMConfig, currentProvider, isConfigured } = useLLM(); const [showSettings, setShowSettings] = useState(false); return (
{showSettings && (

Choose LLM Provider

{currentProvider === 'gemini' && (

Gemini Configuration

updateGeminiConfig({ apiKey: e.target.value })} placeholder="Enter your Gemini API key" />
updateGeminiConfig({ temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })} />
)} {currentProvider === 'vllm' && (

vLLM Configuration

updateVLLMConfig({ baseUrl: e.target.value })} placeholder="http://localhost:8000" />
updateVLLMConfig({ model: e.target.value })} placeholder="llama-2-7b-chat" />
updateVLLMConfig({ temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })} />
updateVLLMConfig({ maxTokens: parseInt(e.target.value) })} min="100" max="4000" />
)}
{isConfigured() ? ( ✅ Configured ) : ( ❌ Configuration Required )}
)}
); }; export default LLMSettings;
